# Entries for TestSpecExamples (tests/specexamples_test.go).
#
# An entry starts with "== FILE SECTION | FIRST LINE", the key the test
# prints for a block. Its lines are:
#
#   skip: REASON       the block is not compiled
#   known: CAUSE ...   the block fails; CAUSE is a roadmap item number,
#                      "spec example wrong" or "no item"; the test fails
#                      when the block starts to pass
#   mode: MODE         build in kernel or freestanding mode
#   sig: SIGNATURE     the function the statements go in
#   values: top        var and const declarations go to package level
#   with: KEY          the block assumes the declarations of block KEY
#   pre:               package-level declarations the block assumes
#   body:              statements before the block's statements
#   tail:              statements after the block's statements
#
# pre:, body: and tail: take the tab-indented lines that follow.

with: 07-types.md 7.9 | type Reader interface {
